hero.subtext: Platypus Outdoor Solutions provides shoreline restoration, pressure washing, and exterior cleaning services across Central Florida using eco-conscious, chemical-free methods.

beforeAfter.description: Each restoration is documented before, during and after — so you know exactly what you're paying for.

process.headline: A simple process, start to finish.
process.description: You stay in control at every step. No surprise invoices, no chemical smells, no contractor disappearing acts.

steps.title: Free quote
steps.description: Send photos or fill out a 60-second form. Estimate within 24 hours.

steps.title: On-site assessment
steps.description: We visit, measure, and walk you through the plan — no obligation.

steps.title: Eco-friendly restore
steps.description: Soft-wash, sealants, and biodegradable solutions. Most projects in under a week.

steps.title: Walkthrough & guarantee
steps.description: You sign off only when it's right. Backed by our 12-month guarantee.

scarcity.headline: Reserve your restoration slot.
scarcity.body: We protect availability — only 4 active projects per crew at a time. Pick a target start week and we'll send a free quote within 24 hours.
scarcity.disclaimer: No spam. No deposit required. Free estimate in 24h.

serviceArea.headline: Central Florida waterfront, edge-to-edge.
serviceArea.description: From Mount Dora down to Celebration — if it's a Central Florida lake, river or canal, we've cleaned a property on it.

about.headline: About Platypus Outdoor Solutions
about.subheadline: Transforming outdoor spaces across Central Florida since 2009 with quality craftsmanship and innovative design.
about.story1: Founded in 2009 by Mike Johnson, Platypus Outdoor Solutions began as a small family business with a simple mission: to help Central Florida families make the most of their outdoor spaces.
about.story2: What started as weekend deck projects has grown into a full-service outdoor construction company, but we've never lost sight of our core values: quality craftsmanship, honest communication, and treating every project like it's our own backyard.
about.story3: Today, we're proud to have transformed hundreds of outdoor spaces across Orlando, Apopka, Winter Garden, and surrounding communities. Each project tells a story, and we're honored to be part of creating spaces where memories are made.

footer.tagline: Family-owned eco-friendly waterfront restoration. Serving Central Florida since 2018.
